reference.description: Declared reading-normalized derivative of independently supplied publisher gold. Both candidate and reference receive the same conversion; raw diplomatic text remains separately preserved.

literalCandidateSource: Original saved per-page outputs, before reading normalization; no source or provider wording is rewritten.
headlineMetric: The standard report uses lexical-normalized WER/CER. These separate fidelity diagnostics preserve punctuation, case, glyphs and formatting.

evaluation.referenceTextScope: Exhaustive lexical target for the declared input page/crop; drawing syntax is excluded where the publisher serialization declares it.
evaluation.structureAccuracyUnavailableReason: Text-only OCR does not establish column/region localization or page layout. An article crop does not establish whole-page reading order.
evaluation.lexicalMetricLimitation: Headline WER/CER use the existing case-insensitive lexical normalization and declared reference order. Reading-order or serialization differences can increase edit distance; these scores do not measure layout or exact glyph/punctuation fidelity.
evaluation.fidelityMetricLimitation: Literal numeric, punctuation and whitespace comparisons are representation-fidelity diagnostics. TSV tabs, span-continuation blanks, Markdown wrappers and source case conventions can differ without establishing a recognition error.
evaluation.lexicalNormalization: NFKC, declared quote/dash folding and whitespace folding applied to BOTH reference and candidate before existing OCR WER/CER normalization; raw texts preserved privately.

pageBoundaryPolicy: The exact single-page reference and saved page text retain their whitespace apart from line-ending/final-newline convention.

literalNumbers.policy: Exact ASCII-digit substrings retain adjacent currency/signs, commas/decimals, exponent notation, percent/per-mille and paired parentheses. Duplicate matches count separately. Sequence comparison uses the declared reference order; multiset coverage ignores order. No numeric-value equivalence, localization or cell/branch association is inferred; incidental duplicate numbers can match.

providers.policy: Whole-document, case/punctuation/Unicode-sensitive text comparison normalizes only line endings and final newline. Punctuation/symbol diagnostics preserve Unicode punctuation and symbol order. These are representation-fidelity measures: source heading case, derived TSV whitespace, drawing serialization and output Markdown wrappers can affect them. They do not establish table cells, branch mapping or page geometry.

tokenMultiset.policy: Order-insensitive normalized token multiset precision/recall/F1 against the exhaustive declared page/crop reference. Exact duplicate occurrence counts are retained; NFKC and declared reading normalization apply to BOTH texts before existing OCR tokenization. High F1 with poor ordered WER can suggest sequence/serialization differences; this is not spatial accuracy or proof of visual correctness.

repetition.policy: Counts only: split actual CR/LF and literal escaped newline markers, then apply the same declared reading normalization within each nonempty logical line. Duplicate occurrences count total minus unique lines. Repetition may be legitimate; compare source counts and token precision/recall. No page geometry, repeated string or source wording is emitted.
